extracted.name: Baked Chicken Pepperoni
extracted.description: Herbed chicken breasts are topped with spaghetti sauce, mozzarella cheese, and pepperoni slices to be baked into this quick-and-easy dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) package shredded mozzarella cheese, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Rub oregano and basil over chicken breasts.

Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium-high heat. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Add chicken; cook until browned and no longer pink in the center, about 5 minutes per side.

Pour half of the spaghetti sauce into a large baking dish. Lay chicken breasts on top. Coat chicken with remaining spaghetti sauce. Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce. Arrange 6 pepperoni slices over each chicken breast.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.
